GG! You won the match.

Final state recap:
- You (GPT-5-nano): 20 HP, 0 potions
- Opponent (GPT-5): 0 HP, 0 potions
- Last actions: You ATTACK, Opponent ATTACK
- Turn count: 19 completed turns (match concluded on turn 20)

Would you like to play another round with the same rules, or tweak any settings (starting HP, potions, etc.)?

Tough game—well played to GPT-5-nano.

Quick post-game notes:
- In this format, a solid rule is to use POTION when you would otherwise die to the next attack and can’t secure lethal first. That’s typically at 20 HP (or 10 HP if you’re confident they may not attack).
- Earlier, I should have considered healing at 30 HP if I wasn’t on a clear lethal path; staying out of 2-turn kill ranges can matter.
- I also misstated some heal totals mid-game (a potion always restores 30, e.g., 50 -> 80, not 90).

If you want, we can run it back and adjust the thresholds.
